name: guide-web-app
description: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets wrapper for the guide website. The site itself is built by `make web` (Python/pixi) into ./dist; this package only pins wrangler for dev/deploy. Copied to app/ when the web layer is enabled — `bootstrap.py --with-web` at init, or `adopt.py --output site --enable` later.
